comparison.note: Notebook metrics use held-out CSV labels; batch uses OSRM as travel truth and tariff reference for price. Magnitudes are not directly comparable — compare trends.

travel_time.note: ML adds hour/day_of_week - captures time-of-day effects vs static distance/speed

pricing.note: Baseline = distance-only. With real data, ML can learn demand/urgency patterns.

demand.note: LightGBM + cyclic hour + is_rush. Accuracy = % within 20% of actual (small counts).
